text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo Cross is apparently having a match race with Gold City.
Heading over to the track to watch—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
It's Gold City...! 
Even in a gym jersey, she's gorgeous as ever...

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, look at this massive crowd!
Impressive, they're all here to see ya, ain't they?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...Ah, sorry about that,
Tamamo-senpai.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Seems like the rumor that I was running
leaked out somewhere.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Nah, don't sweat it! The rowdier it gets,
the more fired up I am!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Yeah. ...Besides, this is my chance to show this many people what my running is made of.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Get fired up, me.
I am definitely gonna win this...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
With countless spectators watching closely,
the race got underway.

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Ora oraaa!
I'll show ya the "White Lightning" of Naniwa!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Kgh...! 
—Don't mess with me, not yetttt!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: —The fiercely contested race ended with Gold City suffering a narrow defeat.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Aaargh! Dammit, dammit, dammit!
I lost...! And I was so sure I'd win!

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
...I gotta run even more. More and more.
Until the results follow—

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
...Ya seem pretty irritated, but
ain't things actually lookin' pretty good?

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text: C'mon, take a good look around ya, City.

text_block_list.name: Spectator B
text_block_list.text:
Even though she lost, that was an amazing race.
Gold City might really be someone to watch out for.

text_block_list.name: Spectator C
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, what a closing stretch. If she keeps growing like this,
she could make it all the way to GⅠ, don't you think?

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: —Guess this is no time to throw a tantrum, huh.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
Tamamo-senpai, let's do this again.
Just so you know, I won't lose next time!

text_block_list.name: Tamamo Cross
text_block_list.text:
Hell yeah! Next time then,
let's meet in an official race!
